newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo jumps on expected price cut.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo jumps on expected price cut.

text.p: Shares in Nintendo Co Ltd jumped on Monday morning as the video game maker's planned cut in the U.S. price of its 64-bit video game machine continued to support its shares, traders said.
At 0150 GMT, the share price was up 230 yen at 8,890 yen on the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE). Volume was 301,100 shares.
A Japanese daily reported on Thursday that Nintendo plans to cut the price of the video game machine to about $150 from $199 currently.
A Nintendo official told Reuters on Monday that its U.S. unit was responsible for its game machine business in the United States and he could not comment on whether the price would be reduced.
He added that the U.S. unit had not announced any price cut in the 64-bit machine on the U.S. market.
